name: IndieMade
summary: Independent online store builder for makers and small sellers, with two-way Etsy sync, unlimited products and no platform transaction fees.
best_for: makers and small sellers who want their own store, with two-way Etsy sync, and no platform transaction fees
skip_if: you need a published price before you start, you want a marketplace that brings you buyers, or you sell outside US dollars and need a currency switch
honest_knock: The pricing page no longer shows plan prices, so you only see the cost at signup. Help articles disagree about whether the AI integration is in Plus only, and we did not check how cancellation works inside the dashboard.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-09 on indiemade.com/plans-pricing) IndieMade lists two plans, Essential and Plus, and every plan starts with a 30-day free trial that needs no credit card. The pricing page now says the live plan lineup is shown at signup, so we cannot quote a current monthly price; an earlier reading on 16 October 2026 showed Essential at $15 a month and Plus at $25 a month, with lower rates billed annually, but that is not on the page today. The page says IndieMade adds no listing fee and no transaction fee on any plan, and that you take payments through your own Stripe, Square or PayPal account, whose processing fees are separate. Hosting is included and every plan supports a custom domain. Unlimited products are included on every plan. The terms state prices in US dollars.

source_quotes.quote: Plus Everything in Essential, and more $25 / month $20/mo billed annually
Essential The complete store $15 / month $12/mo billed annually
30-day free trial. No credit card required.
